name: Address search (OpenStreetMap)
description: Finds an address's latitude and longitude with OpenStreetMap data (ODbL). getcadcraft.com asks OpenStreetMap's Nominatim for you (at most one request a second; answers kept 90 days under a hash of the address, never who asked). Asks only when you press its button in Surface › More › Address to site; no key, nothing at start-up; this browser keeps the answer 24 hours.
author: CadCraft
